children: According to Sina Finance, Yonhap, citing anonymous industry sources, reported that the SK Hynix union approved a revised wage and collective bargaining agreement reached with management. In the revote, the revised agreement received 57.08% support. The new deal raises the cash portion of profit sharing from 40% to 50% and cuts the equity portion from 60% to 50%.

title: SK Hynix Union Approves Revised Wage Agreement in Revote
